name: SaaS admin with a temporary password is held at the password change screen
title: SC-06-06-01 SaaS admin with a temporary password is held at the password change screen
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given a SAAS_ADMIN account with must_change_[redacted] the user signs in with the temporary password
Then the password change screen is shown instead of the dashboard
And no business data is requested from the server
When the user sets a new valid password
Then the SAAS_ADMIN home page is shown with the role's data
And signing in again with the new password does not ask for a change
